title: fix(devx): check-comment-mask-corpus no longer drops argv[0] when --masker is absent
body:
Closes #16540

## The bug

`scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`'s `main()` computed the argv left over after `--masker PATH` as:

```js
const rest = argv.filter((arg, index) => index !== maskerFlag && index !== maskerFlag + 1);
```

`argv.indexOf('--masker')` returns `-1` when the flag is absent, and `-1 + 1 === 0` — so the filter treated "no `--masker` anywhere" the same as "drop index 0", removing `argv[0]` from the very list the unknown-option check reads next. An unknown option typed in first position (`--no-such-flag`, or any future `--json`/`--shard`/`--since`) was silently dropped, the usage check never fired, and the script fell through to the full 6,484-file sweep and exited 0.

## The fix

Extracted the computation into a pure, directly-testable `argvAfterMasker(argv, maskerFlag)` and guarded the sentinel:

```js
export function argvAfterMasker(argv, maskerFlag) {
  return maskerFlag === -1 ? argv : argv.filter((arg, index) => index !== maskerFlag && index !== maskerFlag + 1);
}
```

When `--masker` is absent, `rest` is now `argv` **itself** (same reference), not a filtered copy missing its first element.

### `--self-test` — dead-code check on the issue's suggested patch

The issue's suggested patch appended `&& arg !== '--self-test'` to the unknown-option filter. Measured before writing anything: `--self-test` is dispatched by the entrypoint block —

```js
if (argv.includes('--self-test')) { /* ... calls selfTest() ... */ }
else await main(argv);
```

— so `main()` (where the `unknown` filter lives) **never receives `--self-test`** when invoked via the CLI; that path is prevented from ever reaching `main()` at all. The clause would be dead code here, so it was **not** ported.

## Before / after measurement

Run in a fresh worktree after `pnpm install` (`@typescript-eslint/parser` present), same tree (`origin/main` @ `cca1dc0bfb`):

| | command | exit code | wall clock |
|---|---|---|---|
| **before** | `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs --no-such-flag` | **0** (ran the full sweep — 6,484 files, "0 disagree") | **51.4s** |
| **after** | `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs --no-such-flag` | **2** (`EXIT_USAGE`) | **55ms** |

After:
```
unknown option(s): --no-such-flag
usage: node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs [--self-test] [--masker PATH]
```

## Reverse control — the untouched half did not move

`--masker` in first position is the one shape the bug never affected (`maskerFlag` is a real index there, so the filter always behaved). Run **both** before and after the fix, under this container's shared verify lock (`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`), same command:

```
node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs --masker scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs
```

| | exit code | wall clock (shared-box seconds — lock held, not an idle-box reading) | self-test cases reported |
|---|---|---|---|
| **before fix** | 0 | 53.0s | 17 |
| **after fix** | 0 | 54.2s | 26 |

Same shape (0 disagree, 0 unparseable, `EXIT` 0) both times — the difference is only the self-test case count, which is the *intended* change (9 new `--self-test` cases added for #16540), not a regression. The half this PR didn't touch didn't move.

## `--self-test`

Added 9 cases (floor raised `17 → 26`, per this repo's assertion-floor culture, #13799):

- direct, on `argvAfterMasker()` (no process spawn, fast):
  - `rest === argv` (same reference) when `--masker` is absent
  - `--masker` in first position still drops exactly its flag and value (regression)
  - an unknown option is read from `argv[0]` with `--masker` absent
  - an unknown option is read from a **middle** position with `--masker` absent
  - an unknown option is read from the **last** position, after `--masker` consumes its two slots
- spawned, on a **real child process** (following the objectui port's approach, so the exit code is pinned as an actual number the OS returned, not a value this file made up):
  - `--no-such-flag` at `argv[0]` exits `EXIT_USAGE` (`typeof status === 'number' && status === 2`)
  - the usage error names the unknown flag
  - it answers in well under a second — proof it never reaches the sweep
  - an unknown option **after** `--masker` also exits `EXIT_USAGE` as a number

Full run:

```
$ node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs --self-test
...
ok   #16540 -- with --masker absent, rest is argv ITSELF (same reference), not a copy missing argv[0]
ok   #16540 regression -- --masker in FIRST position still drops exactly its flag and value
ok   #16540 -- an unknown option is read from argv[0] when --masker is absent
ok   #16540 -- an unknown option is read from a MIDDLE position, no --masker
ok   #16540 -- an unknown option is read from the LAST position, after --masker consumed its two slots
ok   #16540 spawned -- --no-such-flag at argv[0] exits EXIT_USAGE as a NUMBER (not a full sweep)
ok   ...and the usage error names the unknown flag
ok   ...and it answers in well under a second -- it never reaches the sweep
ok   #16540 spawned -- an unknown option AFTER --masker also exits EXIT_USAGE as a NUMBER
...

All 26 self-test cases passed.
```

## Scope and other gates

Only `scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` was touched. The `dispatch-gates.mjs`-derived family for this diff is 31 commands; all 31 ran and passed (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE` → "31 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED"), including the gate itself (`node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` — the production sweep, exit 0) and its `--self-test`.

No package under `packages/*` publishes anything under `scripts/` (measured: no `package.json` in the workspace has a `files[]` entry naming a `scripts` path, and the repo root `package.json` is `"private": true`), so this diff carries no published surface.

**Clause-②**: no
